sentences.text: Learned advocate Mr. Imran Pathan states that he has an instructions to appear for the victim girl.
He is permitted to file his appearance forthwith.

He further submits that though the respondent No.2 - complainant who happens to be father of the victim girl is not ready and willing to give his consent for quashing of the impugned FIR, as the victim girl will marry the applicant as soon as he is released from Jail and the father of the applicant who is present in the Court has assured this Court that marriage of the applicant and victim girl will be done upon the applicant being released from Jail and considering Hirabhai Vanabhai Sadhmiya Devipujak vs State Of Gujarat on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67120863/
1 the welfare of the newly wedded couple, the impugned FIR may be quashed and set aside.
2. Rule. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor as well as learned advocate appearing for the Complainant waive service of Rule on behalf of the respective respondents.

sentences.text: Considering the issue involved in the present application and with consent of the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties as well as considering the fact that the dispute amongst the applicant and the victim girl has been resolved amicably, this application is taken up for final disposal forthwith.

4. By way of this application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as "BNSS"), the applicant has prayed for quashing and setting aside F.I.R.
No.11211010230006 of 2023 registered with Chuda Police Station, Dist. Surendranagar for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(j) of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3(A) and 4 of the POCSO Act as well as all other consequential proceedings arising out of the aforesaid FIR qua the applicant.
5. Learned advocate for the applicant has taken this Court through the factual matrix arising out of the present application.

At the outset, it is submitted that the parties have amicably resolved the issue and therefore, any further continuance of the proceedings pursuant to the impugned FIR as well as any further proceedings arising therefrom would create hardship to the applicant.

It is submitted that victim girl has filed an affidavit in these proceedings and has declared that the dispute between the applicant and victim girl is resolved due to intervention of trusted persons of the society.
It is further submitted that in view of the fact that the dispute is resolved, the trial would be futile and any further continuance of the proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.

It is therefore submitted that this Court may exercise its inherent powers conferred under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13560/2025 ORDER DATED:
06/08/2025 undefined Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and allow the application as prayed for.
6.

Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State has opposed the present application and submitted that considering the seriousness of the offence, the complaint in question may not be quashed and the present application may be rejected.
7. Learned advocate for the victim girl has reiterated the contentions raised by the learned advocate for the applicant.
The learned advocate for victim girl also relied upon the affidavit filed by victim girl dated 19.6.2025.
The victim girl is present in person before the Court and is identified by learned advocate Mr. Imran Pathan.

On inquiry made by the Court, the victim girl has declared before this Court that the dispute between her and the applicant is resolved and she will marry the applicant as soon as the applicant is released from Jail.

The father of the applicant, namely,
Vanabhai Valubhai Sadhmiya (Devipujak) is present in the Court and is identified by learned advocate Mr. Pathan and he also filed an affidavit clearly stating that the marriage of the applicant and the victim girl could not take place as the applicant is in Jail but as soon as he is released from Hirabhai Vanabhai Sadhmiya Devipujak vs State Of Gujarat on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67120863/
2 Jail, at the earliest, the marriage of the applicant and victim girl shall take place and, therefore,
despite the fact that the original complainant has objection against the quashment of the impugned FIR, looking to the welfare of the newly wedded couple, the present application may be allowed.
8.
